positive_protocol.name: bounded recipient-private speculative quarantine
invariants: V source physical AR is legitimate under V own successful READ. Unknown A never becomes a sponsor or a cause of V source backpressure.

A's independent physical AR must remain unoffered while its translated-result join/replay decision is pending. Once any physical ARVALID is offered, it is immutable and its real R obligation cannot be canceled because quarantine later matches.
Freeze A descriptor/operation generation before V source AR; untrusted object hint selects capture only and never grants permission, attributes, ordering or source stability.
J<=A's actually free reserved private Q; include prior resident and in-flight obligations. Capture only contiguous firstJ words, stopping at capacity without stalling V.
Before A actual own READ grant handshake/access_ok success, captured bytes produce no A logicalR, targetW, completion progress, source firstR credit or software-visible output.

On actual grant, check A request identity/generation, complete requested extent, READ access, physical PA interval, compatible Normal attributes, permission/invalidation obligation, and legal source read/order window.
If valid, atomically adopt the captured prefix as A data, in original offset order exactly once. Accept future issuer beats only while contiguous and real private capacity allows.
If any issuer beat is missed, mark a permanent live-join gap for that generation. V continues; do not repair the gap by holding a later beat or fabricating history.
Retain source READ authority through all delivered/replayed/independently reread source bytes as required. Destination WRITE authorization is checked separately before real physical writes.
Every actual WLAST/B and original logical source RLAST/descriptor ACK belongs to its real request. Prefix adoption cannot manufacture another firstR, RLAST or early job ACK.

arming_and_order.conservative_order: Either A original logical READ is already pending and the V sample belongs to its legal read-operation interval, or a trusted immutable-source contract covers the sample through A's actual read/commit.
arming_and_order.insufficient: Descriptor acceptance alone does not universally establish the original AXI READ ordering point. An untrusted same-object hint provides neither immutability nor an ordering barrier.
arming_and_order.without_immutability: If A source read is not pending until after another required source write, an earlier V snapshot may violate A's original ordering even when late translation returns identical PA. Reject/re-read rather than retroactively authorizing stale data.
arming_and_order.epoch: Different contexts need not have numerically equal epochs. A successful result must match A's original context/request generation and remain valid; the captured source snapshot must match its own issuer/snapshot generation and compatibility contract.
arming_and_order.current_scope: Trusted stable immutable Normal source, no MMIO/device memory, no exclusive/atomic read, no remap/revocation during reuse. General coherence/remap needs a new contract, not this protocol proof.

records: A original descriptor/READ request identity, extent, original order point and generation; use existing fields only when their actual lifetime permits.
Capture provenance: issuer generation, physical start/extent/Normal attrs, source snapshot/lease identity needed by the chosen stable-source contract.
Q owner/generation, prefix first offset, captured count, adopted/retired cursor, next expected live offset, validity/quarantine flag and permanent-gap flag.
A actual READ access_ok/result-cookie/context/epoch obligation; retain required source mapping/range or compiled physical child fields until real read obligations settle.
Actual physical suffix-child versus original logical READ counters and original RLAST identity if partial cached prefix is followed by an independent physical suffix read.
Destination WRITE result/realW/B obligations and error completion remain separate; speculative bytes cannot bypass them.
Original A virtual/source request owner and pre-VALID dispatch state, so the native prepare result can be verified before independent physical sourceAR emission.
actions_new_relative_to_read_ready_befor: Reserve/capture bounded raw bytes for a recipient whose own source translation has not succeeded.
Keep such bytes inaccessible to logical recipient/data-path progress.
Post-sample verification and exactly-once commit or discard.
Nonblocking detachment on a live-stream gap, and explicit unserved-tail read after partial commitment if supported.
Hold independent A source dispatch before its first physical ARVALID; choose replay/join versus an independent read atomically with successful native verification.
irreducible_state_and_actions.not_new_components: A bounded history, consume masks, payload replay, ordinary successful translation checks and trusted PA routing are shared components. This card does not make a field-wide novelty verdict.
irreducible_state_and_actions.no_free_private_fifo_interface: If Q is the existing iDMA internal FIFO, raw-load must not advance original logicalR counters; adoption must mark already resident bytes without pushing/storing a second copy. This requires an explicit raw-load/adopt interface. If quarantine is a separate shim FIFO feeding the normal iDMA FIFO, both capacities are charged; it is not the same-Q implementation.
irreducible_state_and_actions.completion_boundary: The original source engine sees exactly N logical words and one final RLAST. An adopted prefix contributes to its source progress exactly once. If native engine cannot adopt resident bytes or split its original source response, record that required interface rather than assuming a transparent free shim.

concrete_positive_timeline.kind: Legal illustrative events, not DUT timing. Chosen finite R spacing; no full-at-cycle-start FIFO simultaneous pop/push credit is assumed.
concrete_positive_timeline.inputs: N8/Q_A3. A original READ pending before V AR; stable immutable same Normal source. Own WRITE8 already prepared for both flows to isolate pending-READ question. Both actual payload stores have capacity3. Original descriptor/AR/B IDs retained.
concrete_positive_timeline.source_R: V authorized physical sourceAR1; actual source words at cycles2,5,8,11,14,17,20,23. V physical RLAST23. Issuer gaps are memory/service conditions, not waiting for unknown A.
concrete_positive_timeline.prepare: A actual matching own READ result is accepted at endcycle6, after quarantine captured only R1/R2. Q occupancy2 permits R3 at8 without assuming samecycle full-buffer replacement.
concrete_positive_timeline.A_logical_R: Adopt original logical source offsets1/2 at7/8,3/4 at12/13,5/6 at18/19,7/8 at24/25. These are adoption/progress events; captured bytes remain counted resident until actual W consumes them. Original A logical RLAST25.
concrete_positive_timeline.buffer_check: A occupancy reaches3 at source arrivals8 and14, then actual resident writes free space before the next arrival. V occupancy similarly reaches3 at20 and drains21/22 before23. Neither source R is blocked by unknown A. Authorized A writes may normally contend on shared W; no promise of zero V completion impact after A starts real work.
concrete_positive_timeline.final_accounting: Physical sourceAR1/R8; logicalR_V8+logicalR_A8; realW_V8+W_A8; four physicalAW/B perflow; null0. A final completion27, V29 under these hand events, after all respective realBs. No second physical source read caused by speculative capture.
concrete_positive_timeline.limitation: Continuous issuerR at one word/cycle with the same write/B policy can exhaust Q3; early READ grant alone does not guarantee a full tail join. This is an attainable positive protocol sequence, not a throughput theorem.

too_late_match.events: A grant arrives after V word4 has already passed while quarantine stores only first3. There is an actual gap; future tail cannot be attached as if contiguous.
too_late_match.strongest_legal_fallback: If original source-child/adoption interface supports it, match then adopt cached prefix3 and issue one independent A physical suffixAR5 with retained own source READ authority. Return those words as original logical offsets4–8 with original logical RLAST only at8.
too_late_match.full_accounting: V physicalR8 plus A suffixphysicalR5 =13; two physical sourceAR total. Both logicalR8 and realW8 still complete; all actual WRITE children/B and source-child state are charged.
too_late_match.simpler_legal_fallback: If no child/adoption support and no A logical prefix has been exposed, discard quarantine and perform normal A read8; physicalR total16. This is a functional fallback, not the strongest comparison.
too_late_match.commit_rule: Once any A prefix was logically committed, it cannot be discarded/reissued as logical offsets1..8 again. Keep committed progress and reread only unserved suffix, or invoke explicit job failure/cancel protocol.

mismatch.inputs: A successful own grant resolves a different PA, incompatible attributes/extent or invalid snapshot/order generation.
mismatch.result: Before logical commitment discard all quarantine ownership; perform A normal independently translated physical read8 from its actual source. V proceeds.
mismatch.accounting: PhysicalR total16; logicalR8 each; realW8 each on their separately authorized targets. Discard itself issues zero memory reads or writes.

fault.inputs: A actual own READ fails access_ok, even if reporting is suppressed or fault code resembles success.
fault.result: Discard raw bytes, emit no captured A logicalR/targetW, and return genuine A job error through a defined error-capable completion path. Existing NO_ERROR engine behavior cannot be called correct fault handling.
fault.cost: New/connected descriptor-error handling is required if current transport ignores errors. Do not synthesize normal data/ACK or silently resume a forbidden read.

neighbors_and_failure.capacity_gap_after_some_commit: If A cannot drain and an actual issuer beat is missed after prefix commit, retain exactly-once progress and initiate the unserved-source suffix when legal. V must not be held to preserve A eligibility.

complete_strong_ordinary_control.name: fixed bounded source-prefix history with permission-checked replay
complete_strong_ordinary_control.same_contract: Uses the same actual Q, native grant/access_ok/trusted route, frozen descriptor/order/immutable-source assumptions, ordinary source-child support, real WRITE/completion policy and provenance fields; no additional issuer memory read for history.
algorithm: On selected V physical read, reserve A's same Q as a fixed prefix history owner. Store firstJ ordered issuer words and provenance while A translation is pending, without delivering any A logical data.

Stop saving atJ/Q, while issuerR is always allowed to continue. Preserve stored prefix until A verification or timeout/generation cancellation; do not create a sliding history that falsely includes missing earlier offsets.
When actual A own READ grant succeeds, compare request identity/order and PA/attrs/extent/source snapshot exactly. On mismatch/fault discard and use normal independent read/error.
On match expose the stored prefix through exactly-once original-response adoption. Continue attaching live issuer words only if the next expected offset is present and actual Q is available.

At a gap, stop live attachment. Use cached prefix plus independent unserved-tail READ when the real source-child interface permits; otherwise discard before any logical commitment and perform a full normal A READ.
Use the same authorized resident physical WRITE children, genuine WLAST/Bs and original source/descriptor completion.
complete_strong_ordinary_control.result: This complete fixed-history control realizes every quarantine transition in this card at the same abstract fields/interfaces/buffer budget. The above positive timeline and mismatch/late neighbors are identical under both.
complete_strong_ordinary_control.provenance: This is an explicit complete comparison control, not a claim a particular published or production stage78 module already implements post-grant adoption. Root must decide closest primary coverage separately.
complete_strong_ordinary_control.comparison_to_stage78: The capability change from read-ready-before-firstR join is pre-grant capture and post-sample permission/order verification. If stage78 historicalprefix reuse already reserves/retains the same history while own grant is pending and checks this exact contract, it is identical; otherwise this is an extension requiring the explicit new actions/interfaces above.
complete_strong_ordinary_control.no_field_wide_verdict: Protocol equivalence to a designed complete control removes an automatic performance/cost advantage from the present hand example. It does not establish prior publication or disprove a separately identified architectural capability.

decision_for_root.reachable_with_required_interface: Functionally legal under the stated stable-source/order contract and actual successful own-READ verification. Q3 early-match sequence closes with real W/B and no unknown-recipient source stall.
decision_for_root.actual_required_interfaces: Raw private load/adopt or separately counted history; native access_ok and original-request identity; source-child tail-read/reassembly for partialcommit fallback; genuine descriptor errors; retained source/WRITE/invalidation ownership.; pre-VALID A physical-source dispatch decision so normal TL completion cannot race an automatic independent AR
decision_for_root.positive_capability: An own-translation-late recipient can use previously sampled issuer bytes after permission success instead of always issuing a new complete source read.
decision_for_root.remaining_contribution_gate: Find a precise new action/cost guarantee beyond this same-Q fixed-history control, or show exact closest published mechanism lacks the permission/order contract while the complete implementation supplies it. No novelty conclusion from the protocol seat.
decision_for_root.next_minimum_question: Root chooses the trusted immutable-source/originalREAD interval contract and whether same-Q native FIFO adoption is supportable. Without either, the descriptor-only pregrant claim must be narrowed.
decision_for_root.execution: No code, model, tests, builds, papers or board activity.
